name: List All Bank Accounts
description: Returns all bank accounts that meet the filter criteria. Hidden and corporate bank accounts are not returned.

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Comma-separated list of bank account UUIDs to filter by.

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the bank account

responseFields.name: data[].AccountName
responseFields.description: The name of the bank account

responseFields.name: data[].LegalEntityName
responseFields.description: The full legal name given to the business or individual owning the bank account

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
